name: testland/maestro-flows
description: Authors Maestro YAML flow files (`.maestro/*.yaml`) for mobile + web UI automation: declarative `tapOn`, `inputText`, `assertVisible`, `swipe`, targets iOS/Android/Flutter/React Native/web, nested `runFlow` imports, `evalScript` JavaScript hooks. Use when the team has chosen Maestro or wants YAML-declarative tests readable by non-engineers with no compile step. For React Native gray-box use detox-testing; for Flutter first-party use flutter-testing; for black-box cross-platform use appium-testing.
